description: Source code for a wizard in Odoo (OpenERP) that facilitates converting a CRM lead into an opportunity, including form definitions, business logic, and workflow states.

classes.name: make_opportunity
classes.description: Wizard class for converting CRM leads to opportunities, managing form display and processing.

methods.name: _selectopportunity
methods.description: Validates that the lead has an assigned partner and prepares data for opportunity creation.

methods.name: _makeOrder
methods.description: Converts the lead into an opportunity, updates the CRM case, and returns an action to display the new opportunity.
